about: The drawn width of a gamma-ink version 2 stroke (docs/dev/handwriting.md 'Width'): width = size * w when the stroke carries the w channel, else size. The only width law is the client's finishStroke.js bakeWidths, run once when a stroke is finished; the server and every renderer read w. Each row gives a stroke's style (tool, brush, pen), its size, one sample's decoded pressure p (0..1) and altitude a (degrees or null) and expects: w_enc, the integer written to the first sample's w slot (the multiplier times 1000; later samples write deltas), w, the decoded multiplier (null when the style writes no w channel), and width, the drawn diameter in points. The default pen law is w = 1 + (p - 0.5), perfect-freehand's on-screen value at thinning 0.5, capped to [0, 2]; it ignores a. frontend/tests/finishStroke.test.mjs runs bakeWidths on each row and checks encodeStroke/decodeStroke and strokeWidth give w and width; backend/tests/test_shared_fixtures.py builds the stroke with w_enc in its pts (or without a w channel) and checks stroke_polyline gives width. The server also refuses a file where size * max(w) > 100.

rows.note: default pen at rest pressure draws the nominal size
default pen at zero pressure draws half
default pen at full pressure draws one and a half
a quarter pressure on a 2 pt pen
the default pen ignores altitude at any pressure
the widest stroke the server accepts: size * max(w) <= 100
monoline writes no w and draws its size
a highlighter writes no w and draws its size
a mouse or finger stroke (pen false) writes no w and draws its size
